chunks: Verily We sent many apostles before you to their people, who brought clear signs with them. Then We retributed those who were sinful. It is a duty incumbent on Us to help the believers.
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between the messengers' signs and God's promise to help the believers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of divine retribution against those who reject the clear proofs (al-bayinat) brought by the Prophets, while affirming that God's victory (nasr) for the believers is a binding obligation (haqqan 'alayna). It connects the historical pattern of messengers to the ultimate triumph of the Ahl al-Bayt and the faithful, serving as a source of comfort during times of oppression.
